caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden object with a round, flat, disk-shaped end and a cylindrical handle extending from its side. The surface of the disk is ornamented with a carved tulip-like floral motif encircled by a border of small triangular notches. The flower design features a central upright petal with smaller curved petals and leaves radiating outward. The wood is rendered in shades of light to medium brown, with darker accents emphasizing the carved details and contours. The background is an empty, light beige or off-white, with the artist's name "ROY WEBER" written lightly in small letters below the object. There are no additional objects or decorations in the composition.
title: Buttermold
